description: Enumeration defining various file formats used for key materials, including detection and association with file extensions.

classes.name: FileFormat
classes.description: Enum representing different cryptographic file formats (PEM, JKS, PKCS12) with mechanisms for detecting file format based on file extension.

methods.name: orDetect
methods.description: Returns the specified format or detects it based on the file path if not provided.

methods.name: detect
methods.description: Detects the file format based on the extension of the filename.
